questions.question: How many active customers are there in each region?
questions.sql: SELECT "Region", SUM("Active Customers") AS active_customers FROM {{MODEL}} GROUP BY "Region" ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100

questions.question: What is the ending balance by region in the latest month?
questions.sql: SELECT "Region", SUM("Ending Balance") AS ending_balance FROM {{MODEL}} WHERE "Latest Period Flag" = 'Y' GROUP BY "Region" LIMIT 100

expected.sql: SELECT "Region", SUM("Balance Column") AS ending_balance FROM {{MODEL}} WHERE "Snapshot Month" = DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY "Region" LIMIT 100
